schemas.name: source_schema_record
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_schema_record (
  schema_id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source_id        VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  write_table_name VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL
                               CHECK (write_table_name IN (
                                 'domestic_internal_data',
                                 'domestic_external_data'
                               )),
  encoding_version INTEGER      NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (encoding_version = 1),
  schema_hash      BLOB         NOT NULL
                               CHECK (typeof(schema_hash) = 'blob'
                                 AND length(schema_hash) = 32),
  columns_json     TEXT         NOT NULL
                               CHECK (json_valid(columns_json)
                                 AND json_type(columns_json) = 'array'),
  gmt_created      TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (source_id, write_table_name, encoding_version, schema_hash)
)

schemas.name: domestic_internal_data
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE domestic_internal_data (
  id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source_id    VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  store_id     VARCHAR(128),
  product_id   VARCHAR(128),
  schema_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
  values_json  TEXT         NOT NULL
                           CHECK (json_valid(values_json)
                             AND json_type(values_json) = 'array'),
  content_hash BLOB         NOT NULL
                           CHECK (typeof(content_hash) = 'blob'
                             AND length(content_hash) = 32),
  biz_date     TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  period       VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'd'
                           CHECK (period IN ('h','d','w','m','y')),
  gmt_created  TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  CHECK (store_id IS NOT NULL OR product_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (store_id IS NULL OR length(trim(store_id)) > 0),
  CHECK (product_id IS NULL OR length(trim(product_id)) > 0)
)

schemas.name: domestic_external_data
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE domestic_external_data (
  id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source_id    VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  store_id     VARCHAR(128),
  product_id   VARCHAR(128),
  schema_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
  values_json  TEXT         NOT NULL
                           CHECK (json_valid(values_json)
                             AND json_type(values_json) = 'array'),
  content_hash BLOB         NOT NULL
                           CHECK (typeof(content_hash) = 'blob'
                             AND length(content_hash) = 32),
  biz_date     TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  period       VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'd'
                           CHECK (period IN ('h','d','w','m','y')),
  gmt_created  TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  CHECK (store_id IS NOT NULL OR product_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (store_id IS NULL OR length(trim(store_id)) > 0),
  CHECK (product_id IS NULL OR length(trim(product_id)) > 0)
)

schemas.name: domestic_collection_coverage
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE domestic_collection_coverage (
  source_id      VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  period         VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'd'
                             CHECK (period IN ('h','d','w','m','y')),
  store_id       VARCHAR(128),
  product_id     VARCHAR(128),
  coverage_start TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  coverage_end   TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  gmt_created    TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  gmt_modified   TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  CHECK (store_id IS NOT NULL OR product_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (store_id IS NULL OR length(trim(store_id)) > 0),
  CHECK (product_id IS NULL OR length(trim(product_id)) > 0),
  CHECK (coverage_start < coverage_end)
)

schemas.name: __ecomctl_init_state
schemas.sql: CREATE TABLE __ecomctl_init_state (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1), plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL, config_checksum TEXT NOT NULL)

schemas.name: data_source_meta
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE data_source_meta (
  source_id        VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  source_type      VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL
                               CHECK (source_type IN ('api','rpa','mcp','manual')),
  platform         VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL,
  biz_id           VARCHAR(128),
  name             VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  description      TEXT         NOT NULL,
  param_spec       TEXT         NOT NULL,
  data_type        VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL CHECK (data_type IN ('series','brief')),
  data_scope        VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL CHECK (data_scope IN ('internal','external')),
  write_table_name VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL
                               CHECK (write_table_name IN (
                                 'domestic_internal_data',
                                 'domestic_external_data'
                               )),
  enabled          INTEGER      NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0,1)),
  gmt_create       TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  gmt_modified     TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
  ext_info         TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (source_id)
)

schemas.name: domain_knowledge_view
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE domain_knowledge_view (
  region      VARCHAR(8)   NOT NULL CHECK (region IN ('CN','INTL')),
  platform    VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  node_id     VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  parent_id   VARCHAR(128),
  node_name   VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT         NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  data_scope   VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL CHECK (data_scope IN ('internal','external')),
  is_leaf     INTEGER      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_leaf IN (0,1)),
  metric_ids  TEXT         NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  status      VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                           CHECK (status IN ('active','deprecated')),
  PRIMARY KEY (region, platform, node_id)
)

schemas.name: domestic_metric_router_registry
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE domestic_metric_router_registry (
  metric_id      VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  metric_name    VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  description    TEXT         NOT NULL,
  tags           TEXT         NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  platform       VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL,
  data_scope      VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL CHECK (data_scope IN ('internal','external')),
  data_type      VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL CHECK (data_type IN ('series','brief')),
  source_id      VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  value_path     TEXT         NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  auxiliary_path TEXT         NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  source_table   VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL
                             CHECK (source_table IN (
                               'domestic_internal_data',
                               'domestic_external_data'
                             )),
  status         VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                             CHECK (status IN ('active','deprecated')),
  extra          TEXT         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  PRIMARY KEY (metric_id)
)
